exact_claim: For every monomial-free binomial ideal in characteristic zero with a minimal binomial generating system, does its augmented-exponent LP have an optimizer with no other optimizer in the same augmented-image fiber?
source_quantifier: There exists an optimal z such that Az differs from Az_prime for every other optimal z_prime. This is equivalent to a singleton feasible fiber, since the objective is the sum of the final image coordinates. It is not uniqueness of the optimal image vector.
